calls.thesis: Marvell investor day: FY2028 revenue outlook raised to ~$20B, $30 EPS guided for CY2030; at a 30x PE that implies a potential ~$600 stock price.
calls.base: FY2028 guide raised $18B->$20B (from $16.5B two quarters prior), driven by networking/scale-up-scale-out; custom silicon FY2029 target >$12B vs $10B+; data-center revenue $18B FY2028, target pulled a year early.
calls.bull: FY2031 model $70-90B revenue implying >$30 non-GAAP EPS at midpoint; he argues management is conservative and real numbers could be much higher.
calls.bear: Numbers are 4-5 years out ('blurriness'); new technologies/networking solutions could end the thesis; no sure thing in this space.
